description: On 18th October 2026, Rotary Club of Deonar held its regular club meeting, celebrating the outstanding contributions of its members. Dr. Himanshu Bendrey, Dr. Pramod Kale and Rtn. Naresh Shenoy were felicitated for their dedicated service. Special recognition was given to Rtn. Naresh Shenoy, Project Chairman of the Musculoskeletal Corrective Surgery Project, for his commitment of over 20 years and an incredible contribution towards facilitating more than 6,000 corrective surgeries, helping beneficiaries regain mobility and improve their quality of life. The meeting was followed by a vibrant Dandiya Night, bringing together Rotarians, their families and Annettes for an evening of fellowship, music and celebration.

gallery.alt: Doctors associated with the Musculoskeletal Corrective Surgery Project are felicitated for their dedicated service, while Mini is formally inducted as a new member of Rotary Club of Deonar.
Dr. Pramod Kale is felicitated in recognition of his outstanding contribution to the Musculoskeletal Corrective Surgery Project.
Rotary Club of Deonar felicitates its members for their long-standing commitment and contribution to community healthcare, including over 6,000 corrective surgeries.
Rotarians and their families enjoy an evening of music, traditional Dandiya and fellowship following the regular club meeting.
Rtn. Mini is formally welcomed as a new member of Rotary Club of Deonar by Club President Nalini Kannan, and presented with her Rotary membership kit, marking the beginning of her Rotary journey.
